name: Ashoka Refineries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Ashoka Refineries Ltd is engaged in the trading of goods.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) Trading: Import, export, buy, sell, and indent oil and oil-related products.
b) Manufacturing: Manufacture, refine, and process oil and related substances.
c) Plant Operations: Set up and operate oil extraction and refining plants with infrastructure.
d) Cargo Handling: Manage transport, storage, and movement of oil products.
e) Wholesale & Retail: Trade oil and oil-related products in domestic and international markets.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -0.75% over last 3 years.
